newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Tunisian PM arrives in Morocco to warm up ties.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian PM arrives in Morocco to warm up ties.

text.p: Tunisian Prime Minister Hamed Karoui arrived on Tuesday in Morocco for a two day visit on bilateral relations and boosting economic ties, a Moroccan official said.
Karoui, who was greeted at Rabat airport by Moroccan Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali, will jointly preside the meeting of the Tunisian-Moroccan high commission in Rabat, the official, said.
Karoui told reporters earlier "the commission's meeting is expected to evaluate the bilateral relations and examine possibilities to develop business between Tunisia and Morocco."
A Western diplomat said the Tunisian prime minister would also discuss a future official visit of Tunisian President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali to Morocco.
Relations between Rabat and Tunis reached a low level in the last three years due to differences over several regional issues including Moslem fundamentalism in North Africa, he added.
